audience: employers and payroll admins who track hours and time off in Buddy Punch

useCases.title: Review who clocked in and when
useCases.text: List the time cards of a pay period, then the punches of one card. Open a punch to read its in and out times and location.

useCases.title: Check time card totals for a pay period
useCases.text: List the pay periods, then the time cards of one period. Read the regular, overtime and break totals of a card.

useCases.title: See the scheduled shifts at a location
useCases.text: List the work locations. Read the published shifts for a date range, filtered by location.

useCases.title: Clock an employee in or out
useCases.text: Find the employee id in the employee list. Record a clock-in or clock-out now or at a given time.

useCases.title: Start and end a break
useCases.text: Start a break under a break rule. End the open break of the same employee when the break is over.

useCases.title: Request time off for an employee
useCases.text: List the time off types, then create a request for an employee by day or date range.
